title: OCCURRENCE OF A CYBER SECURITY ECO-SYSTEM: A NATURE ORIENTED PROJECT AND EVALUATION OF AN INDIRECT SOCIAL EXPERIMENT
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not conduct any benchmarks related to faith or religion. It is an observational study of a cybersecurity educational project.
findings: This paper contains no findings related to religion or faith. The study focuses on the educational outcomes and unexpected social dynamics that emerged from a cybersecurity training camp for high school students.
